1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, and zirconium tetrachloride.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, and __zirconium oxychloride__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium, or calcium ions, wherein the concentration of said cations is __less than 5% by weight__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 800 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __selectively entrapping a multivalent cation__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the concentration of said multivalent cation is __at least 0.1% by weight__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said polyanion__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __other anionic polymers__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, and freshwater__.
